These small test-only audio fixtures are from the MIT-licensed `audiojs/decode` repository:

- `video-aac.mp4` — `packages/decode-mp4/fixtures/video-aac.mp4`
- `alac24-mono.m4a` — `packages/decode-aac/fixtures/alac24_mono.m4a`

Upstream: https://github.com/audiojs/decode. The upstream MIT license is included as `LICENSE-audiojs.txt`. They are used only to exercise local MP4/M4A decoding in tests and are not included in production builds.
